name: Locusts
desc: Destroy crops rapidly. Use bio-pesticides and timely monitoring.
details: Locusts are migratory pests that can devastate crops quickly. Control involves early monitoring, mechanical control, and eco-friendly bio-pesticides such as Metarhizium anisopliae. Avoid over-irrigation which encourages breeding.

name: Rice Blast
desc: Fungal disease reducing yield. Resistant varieties help.
details: Rice blast, caused by the fungus Magnaporthe oryzae, affects leaves, nodes, and panicles. Use resistant rice varieties, ensure proper spacing for ventilation, and apply tricyclazole if necessary.

name: Aphids
desc: Suck sap and spread viruses. Neem spray helps control.
details: Aphids cluster on the underside of leaves, sucking plant sap. They transmit viruses. Regular neem oil or soap sprays and encouraging natural predators like ladybugs can help reduce infestation.

name: Powdery Mildew
desc: White fungal growth. Sulfur-based sprays are effective.
details: Powdery mildew appears as white powdery spots on leaves and stems. It thrives in dry, warm conditions. Ensure proper air circulation and use sulfur-based or potassium bicarbonate sprays.

name: Stem Borers
desc: Damage maize & rice stems. Use pheromone traps & resistant seeds.
details: Stem borers bore into plant stems, weakening the structure and reducing yield. Prevent using pheromone traps, timely irrigation, and resistant hybrids. Remove infested stems after harvest.

name: Leaf Rust
desc: Affects wheat leaves. Apply fungicides as per guidelines.
details: Leaf rust is caused by Puccinia triticina fungus, forming orange pustules on leaves. Use resistant varieties and apply fungicides like propiconazole as per agricultural recommendations.
